note: Per-device GasAccount design. Run 1 published the head sui_edge and fleet_storage fixture (cached by content hash) and stopped on a harness assertion (owner rendering 'shared'). Run 2 reused the fixture and stopped on a harness effects-format assertion after a successful draw that left the budget version unchanged. Run 3 reused the fixture and passed every check. Runs 1 and 2 left their budgets funded; both were reclaimed with the owner cap (cleanup). No contract failure caused a stop.
